title: N
body: As a young girl with a lot of hectic mornings this app is starting to really help me!!! DEFINITELY RECOMMEND 👌but maybe if you can maybe take a look at the timers it would really help bc I think it would be a but more comfortable for some people if they could work at their own time and maybe get a few reminders but you know what I mean 🙃
author: Nallsie

title: I love this app!
body: I’m so happy I found this app, it’s so simple to use, and works so well for someone like me who has ADHD. It’s made me enjoy setting and completing routines! Who’d have thought that could be possible!
author: Emmburgs

title: This is it! This is the app!! 🤍🤍
body: Been using it (almost) daily for my morning and evening routines! Love the motivating reminders for when it’s time to start the routine, love the interface, very intuitive to use, overall REALLY GREAT APP 🤍 My one con would be the fact that the app doesn’t automatically move to the next habit after the timer is up and I have to manually click next~ 🤷‍♀️ Das it 👌
author: Faye8363
